name: The Sea God Surveys (iQPS Launch 9)
agency: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space
location_str: Rocket Lab LC-1A @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
destination_explanation: Most of the satellites working today are down here, which has made this by far the most crowded stretch of space around the planet.
slot_a_text: Synthetic aperture radar Earth observation satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company iQPS.
slot_b_text: It has already slipped twice. The current time was set 10 days ago and has held since. There is a 1.8-hour window to work with.
